name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants from the European Commission's upcoming white paper on the future of European defence. It calls for much higher defence spending, joint buying of weapons, more military aid to Ukraine, and a stronger European defence industry. It also asks the EU to prepare for worst-case military scenarios and to reduce reliance on non-EU countries. This is a set of demands and opinions; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for higher spending, joint procurement and more aid to Ukraine.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, the defence industry, and Ukraine.
- **What happens next:** The Commission's white paper and EU leaders' decisions will follow.
